plain_english: Cultivated by seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count — he, the great Lord: glory-of-release proceeds.
sanskrit_cite: pramātṛsaptakatvena ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṅkhyayā bhāvitaḥ | sa maheśāno mokṣalakṣmīḥ pravartate

plain_english: Its stages — views and the rest, all of them, no doubt. Made-up are stages: as an actor assumes by his own will, so the bliss-will-spread self assumes vast views-and-powers.
sanskrit_cite: tadbhūmikā darśanādyās sarvā eva na saṃśayaḥ | bhūmikāḥ kṛtrimā yadvan naṭo gṛhṇāti svecchayā

plain_english: Bliss-spread self, having assumed vast views-and-powers, shines. From tightening of own power, in wandering, it becomes impure.
Incomplete — 'thus am I incomplete' — by various impurities defiled; named of-māyā-inoffensive-karma; all-pervading too, world-Lord.
sanskrit_cite: apūrṇo 'smīti vividhair malaiḥ | māyīyāṇavakārmākhyair vyāpako 'pi jagadvibhuḥ

plain_english: All-pervading — just as the great god does five acts, so this self too does — deluded by power.
sanskrit_cite: vyāpī yadvan mahādevaḥ kroti pañcakṛtyatām | tadvad evāyam ātmāpi kurute śaktimohitaḥ

plain_english: Capable — from expansion, power-Lord is sung by truth-teachers. From contraction, contracted, as wanderer is called.
sanskrit_cite: śakto vikāsāc chaktīśo gīyate tattvavādibhiḥ | saṅkocanāt saṅkocitaḥ saṃsārīty abhidhīyate

plain_english: Māyā — form indeed — which, somewhat intent to perceive, should know as made-creation. The other power — preservation is considered; from dissolution, the withdrawn goddess is considered.
sanskrit_cite: māyā rūpaṃ hi yat kiṃcid ālokayitum udyatā | anyā śaktiḥ sthitir matā

plain_english: From dissolution, the withdrawn goddess — in unity-of-consciousness, grace is considered. From manifesting that essence, concealment is called.
Thus always present five-course, in order known — wish-jewel. That from ignorance — like wood and clod.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sadā saṃnihitaḥ pañcavāhavidhiḥ | cintāmaṇir asāv ajñānāt kāṣṭaloṣṭavat
